meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 读取迁移交接文件,若未先运行 migrate-v2.sh 会提示先执行;随后完成 v1→v2 迁移的人工部分:确认所有者并赋 owner 角色、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置、移植 fork 的 v1 自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你说「migrate from v1」「finish migration」「v1 migration」等,或要求完成 v1→v2 迁移时触发;前提是已运行 bash migrate-v2.sh 且交接文件存在。

say.text: 我已经跑完 migrate-v2.sh,接着完成迁移吧。
say.note: 脚本会读取交接文件并继续后续步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 v1 的旧记忆迁移到 v2。
检查一下容器配置里的挂载路径。

howto.what_en: Reads the migration handoff file; if migrate-v2.sh hasn't run, it tells you to run that first. Otherwise it finishes the human-judgment parts: confirms the owner and grants the owner role, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and ports custom v1 fork code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", or when you ask to complete a v1→v2 migration. It requires that bash migrate-v2.sh has run and the handoff file exists.

say_en.text: I've run migrate-v2.sh already — let's finish the migration.
say_en.note: It reads the handoff and continues.

say_en.text: Help me migrate my v1 legacy memory to v2.
Check the mount paths in the container config.
